prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph, low angle through a cheap fisheye lens, grainy 1990s 35mm colour negative, slightly underexposed. A figure in a black balaclava and puffer jacket sits on a brownstone stoop at dusk, holding a cracked school chalk slate on its knees that reads "THE 10 MONEY COMMANDMENTS" above roman numerals I to X. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. Sodium streetlight from the left, cold blue sky above and bent railings curving at the frame's edges. Thanks.
